cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Fenn Everly just flew past at 26 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: What a pass!
cues.body: Dane Corvel just played the hardest pass of the match so far.

cues.headline: Harbor City slip the press
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are pressing, but Harbor City keep playing out: 7 ways past the first line in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 6.0 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Harbor City are sitting back
cues.body: Harbor City have dropped off: their defence now stands 26 m from goal, where it was 42 m. With the score level, Elmstead Wanderers will smell a chance.

cues.headline: GOAL! Yann Morrow!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 1–0 Harbor City. The broken game finally produced a goal. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over: they've had the ball 73% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Elmstead Wanderers are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 47%, Harbor City 53%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: What a ball from Yann Morrow!
cues.body: One pass, 5 Harbor City players taken out. That's how you open a defence.

cues.headline: Pau Petrell scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 1–1 Harbor City. It came 6 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Harbor City have switched it up
cues.body: New shape for Harbor City on the ball: a 3-2-5 now, after a 4-3-3.

cues.headline: Harbor City are on top
cues.body: Harbor City have taken over: they've had the ball 78% of the time in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are bossing the middle
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are winning most of the battles in midfield: 83% of them in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Elmstead Wanderers have had the ball 61% of the time, Harbor City 39%.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over: they've had the ball 69% of the time in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: A tactical tweak from Elmstead Wanderers
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers look different on the ball: a 3-2-5 now, where they were a 5-2-3.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are sitting back
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have dropped off: their defence now stands 27 m from goal, where it was 45 m. With the score level, Harbor City will smell a chance.

cues.headline: It's in! Bram Lindqvist!
cues.body: Bram Lindqvist finds the net for Harbor City: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Harbor City. Against the run of play: Elmstead Wanderers were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 58%, Harbor City 42%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Tired legs at Harbor City
cues.body: Harbor City are slowing down: 58 m a minute per player lately, from 76 m earlier on. Risky for Harbor City while they're protecting a lead.

cues.headline: What a ball from Bram Holm!
cues.body: One pass, 5 Harbor City players taken out. That's how you open a defence.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are on top: recovering the ball 4 times in the final third, winning the ball back in the opposition half 4 times and forcing Harbor City into 4 losses in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Just what Elmstead Wanderers need while they're behind.

cues.headline: GOAL! Hugo Nantes!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 2–2 Harbor City. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control.

cues.headline: Hugo Nantes scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 3–2 Harbor City. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control. It came 6 seconds after Elmstead Wanderers won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers have switched it up
cues.body: New shape for Elmstead Wanderers on the ball: a 3-2-5 now, after a 5-2-3.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 3–2 Harbor City
recap.summary: A deserved win for Elmstead Wanderers.
